notes: The supplied generic noun 'houses' was marked added, against the chapter's own treatment of every other supplied generic completing a present substantive (טַף to 'little ones' in vv. 16, 17, 24, 26; חָלוּץ to 'armed man' in v. 21 and 'man that is armed' in vv. 27, 29). Rule 31 puts such a word inside the substantive's unit with the head on the lexeme-bearing word, and neither of the rules cited in the old note reaches it: rule 20's added clause is for a supplied lexical verb and says in terms that it is not rule 31's generic completion, and rule 33's added clause requires the function word to be supplied as well, whereas the construct relation carries the 'of' here.
